name: agent-engineering-kit
description: Prepare new and existing projects for autonomous agent development.

interface.shortDescription: Set up projects for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Set up a new repository or adapt an existing one for AI-assisted development. AEK builds on your project rules to define how agents plan changes, request approval, and verify their work. Audit a repository without changing files, or upgrade an existing AEK setup. AEK works with local project files and the tools available in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up this new repository for AI-assisted development.
Adapt AEK to this repository and preserve its existing engineering rules.
Audit this repository for AI-assisted development without changing any files.
